snippet.title: FPS Party Game | C4: Classical Caliber Combat Contest | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now to get notified of the DEMO: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339490/C4_Classical_Caliber_Combat_Contest/

C4 is the "kart racer of arena shooters" where classic 2-12 player action meets random item boxes, dynamic stage hazards, ruthless NPC players and the strategic, randomized Contest mode!

Developed by Secret Handshake Interactive

More about the game:
--------------------
Classical Caliber Combat Contest is the "kart racer of arena shooters" where classic movement and weapons meet party game elements like stage hazards, comeback items and a cast of challenging NPC bots.

Wield an enormous collection of weapons against your enemies, including arena shooter favorites and totally new creations! Clean concepts, striking visuals and unique sound effects make each of the 50+ weapons a distinct tool of mayhem. Will your favorite be the classic Rocket Launcher? Or do you prefer the overloaded power of the Shell Compactor?

Each match has a five-weapon arsenal, one for each ammo slot. These weapons appear as pickups on the map, with spawn timers for stronger weapons. After the match concludes players have a short time in the Lobby to collect and play Cards, which level up, override and defend against each other to build the next match.

A cast of computer-controlled characters fight alongside players by navigating the arena, collecting pickups, and shooting weapons like a "real" player. Each of the 12 distinct characters comes with a custom appearance, skill level and text chats to create NPC opponents who aren't afraid to gloat about a kill. You have been warned - the strongest bots possess incredible reflexes and aiming abilities. Invite them to your Contest if you dare.

--------------------
Wishlist now to get notified of the DEMO: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339490/C4_Classical_Caliber_Combat_Contest/
--------------------

Secret Handshake Interactive is brought to you by players like you.
Thank you.
